This piece is small, and it is rented, so I will not put much money there. I will do it the way I know from home and from watching other men nearby: I will plant my maize with another crop in it, use seed I can get cheaply, and put in manure if I have enough at the house. I will not buy fertilizer or spray because one bag is too much for this small field, cash is hard for me, and I do not like spending on rented land.
